name: Regression: Full Chart Type Coverage
description: Tests all available EpochScript chart reporters: Lines, Bars, Scatter, Histogram, Pie, Gauge, Heatmap, BoxPlot, Bubble, Summary Table, Cards
source:
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# Indicators
ret = returns(period=1)(close)
ma20 = sma(period=20)(close)
ma50 = sma(period=50)(close)
vol20 = stdev(period=20)(ret)
rsi = rsi(period=14)(close)
month_num = month()(close)
year_num = year()(close)
monthly_ret = returns(period=21)(close)

# ─── 1. XY LINES (temporal) ───
xy_lines(
    title='Price with Moving Averages',
    category='Lines',
    y_axis_label='Price ($)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.MonetaryFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 50', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.LongDash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(close, ma20, ma50)

# ─── 2. XY LINES area + stacked ───
xy_lines(
    title='RSI with Overbought/Oversold Bands',
    category='Lines',
    y_axis_label='RSI',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=70, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Overbought'),
        ReferenceLine(value=30, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Oversold')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='RSI (14)', color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    order=1
)(rsi)

# ─── 3. XY BARS ───
xy_bars(
    title='Monthly Average Returns',
    category='Bars',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Return',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    mode=required,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Monthly Return', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    order=0
)(values=monthly_ret, label=month_num)

# ─── 4. XY SCATTER ───
xy_scatter(
    title='Return vs Volatility',
    category='Scatter',
    x_axis_label='20-Day Vol',
    y_axis_label='Daily Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily', color=Color.Indigo, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    order=0
)(vol20, ret)

# ─── 5. HISTOGRAM ───
histogram(
    title='Return Distribution',
    category='Histogram',
    bins=40,
    fill_color=Color.Cyan,
    x_axis_label='Daily Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    order=0
)(ret)

# ─── 6. PIE ───
up_days = where(ret > 0, 1, 0)
down_days = where(ret <= 0, 1, 0)
pie(
    title='Up vs Down Days',
    category='Pie',
    colors=[Color.Green, Color.Red],
    order=0
)(label=['Up Days', 'Down Days'], value=[cumsum(up_days), cumsum(down_days)])

# ─── 7. GAUGE ───
gauge(
    title='Current RSI',
    category='Gauge',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    min=0,
    max=100,
    decimal_places=0,
    color=Color.Blue,
    categories=['Oversold', 'Weak', 'Neutral', 'Strong', 'Overbought'],
    order=0
)(value=rsi)

# ─── 8. HEATMAP ───
heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Returns by Month and Year',
    category='Heatmap',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    min_color=Color.Red,
    max_color=Color.Green,
    value_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.1f}%',
    order=0
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=monthly_ret)

# ─── 9. BOXPLOT ───
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='Return Distribution by Month',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Daily Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    median_color=Color.White,
    whisker_iqr=1.5,
    show_outliers=True,
    category='BoxPlot',
    order=0
)(label=month_num, values=ret)

# ─── 10. BUBBLE ───
bubble(
    title='Return vs Vol (sized by volume)',
    category='Bubble',
    x_axis_label='Volatility',
    y_axis_label='Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    series_name='Daily',
    bubble_color=Color.Violet,
    min_bubble_size=3,
    max_bubble_size=15,
    order=0
)(vol20, ret, volume)

# ─── 11. SUMMARY TABLE ───
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Performance Summary',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Return', 'Risk'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Average', 'Std Dev'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Latest Return', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Avg Return', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Std Return', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Latest Vol', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Avg Vol', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Std Vol', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Summary',
    order=0
)(ret, ret, ret, vol20, vol20, vol20)
